title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_the_benedict_option_by_rod_dreher_mywhh (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_the_benedict_option_by_rod_dreher_mywhh' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted machine.
